[[File:FarlanderUniform.jpg|thumb|Keyan Farlander was awarded with Flight Badges for completing various training programs for the Rebel Alliance's starfighters, three of which were placed on his sash.]]

'''Flight Badges''' were badges that were awarded for the successful completion of a starfighter training course in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. By the Battle of Hoth, four were known to have been issued, for the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], and the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]].

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] had received the X-wing, Y-wing, and A-wing Flight Badges, all three of which he had placed on his uniform's sash. He later received the B-wing Flight Badge, although he placed it in a [[Medals case]].
